content:
"skillfully click the link to open the printable version, then fill the grid using the numbers 1 to 9, making sure each digit appears exactly once in every row, column and 3x3 box.

This challenge provides a temporary twist on traditional number puzzles, echoing the unpredictable shifts we see in climate patterns, and asks you to feel the weight of each choice as you proceed.

Imagine the empty squares as a light gas waiting to be filled; each number you place is a tiny particle that must fit perfectly, adding a satisfying twist when the solution finally clicks into place.

When you have completed the grid, purchase next week’s Observer Digital Edition to view the finished puzzle and confirm that every number has been positioned correctly."
